title: Dark mode and a 1024 px window: New Inventory Part field order and validation messages read correctly
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Dark theme turned on with the theme toggle; browser window 1024 px wide. Data: QAPL-T1 (stocked here) and QAPL-E1 (Part Library entry with no part; note its description). Pick Category before typing Cost (known pre-existing: Cost first sends calculate-sell-price with an empty category → 400 "Invalid UUID" / "Failed to calculate sell price.").
custom_steps:
1. On /parts/inventory click New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Save with Description and Part Number empty.
  3. Type Description "QA S7 dark", Part Number "qapl-t1", pick a Category, type Cost 10.00 and click Save.
  4. Change Part Number to "QAPL-E1" and click Save.
  5. Cleanup: open the new part and click Delete Part (button_delete_part).
custom_expected:
1. Description comes before Part Number; Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Cost, Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking, Tags and Inventory bins lay out without clipping or overlap.
  2. "Description is a required field" and "Part number is a required field" are legible against the dark background and not cut off.
  3. The error toast "QAPL-T1 already exists at this location." with "Please try to resolve this." is legible and unclipped.
  4. The dialog closes; the toast "Part created. Linked to QAPL-E1 in the Part Library. Its description "{library description}" was kept." is legible, unclipped and fades on its own.
  5. The part is deleted at once (no confirmation), the dialog closes and the list reloads without it.
